items.hyp: Kayumba yasooka naye mu Kitgum mu 1987, era yali Asumedi wa Disitulikiti.
items.ref: Nasooka kusisinkana Kayumba e Kitgum mu lukumi kinaana mu musanvu bwe yali akola nga amyuka akulira disitulikiti.

items.hyp: Nnamuleetera mu bambe ba National Riffle Association ebya ssentebe, ekyo kyali kikola eby'okukola mu Uganda Peoples Defence Force.
items.ref: Nali ssajenti mu kibinja ky'abayeekera eky'ekkumi n'omwenda ekya National Riffle Association leero ekiyitibwa Uganda People's Defence Force.

items.hyp: Mu 1990 bwe yasalawo mu Gulu.
items.ref: Mu lukumi mu lwenda kyenda twadda ffenna e Gulu.

items.hyp: Nga Okitobba 1, 1990, tukola mu motoonya eyo e Kagitumba ng'ekitongole ky'eby'okulonda kyali kyagala okulwanirira.
items.ref: Nga I Ogwekkumi 1990, twatambulira mu mmotoka emu okugenda e Kigitumba nga Rehabilitation Project Force etongoza olutabaalo.

items.hyp: Ebyo ebirala mu kitongole kya firimu, ekyo kiba kyali kikola ku ngeri y'okukozesa ssente z'okukozesa firimu, nga bwe kiba nti Kodak ne Fuji.
items.ref: Okufuna ekitono mu bya ffirimu, okugeza, olw'okubaawo ebintu ebirala ebirungi ebiyinza okweyambisibwa nga Kodak ne Fuji.

items.hyp: Olw'okuba CinemArena yali yali yaliwo mu nsi z'omu nsi ezitali zikolebwa mu Mozambique, Lebanon, Morocco ne Ethiopia, ekyo kyali kigenda mu Uganda.
items.ref: Oluvannyuma lw'okukozesebwa obulungi mu pulojekiti ezaatambula obulungi Mozambique, Lebanon, Morocco ne Ethiopia, ekisaawe ky'ebya ffirimu kimaze ne kituuka mu Uganda.

items.hyp: CinemArena mu Uganda erina okukola mu kiseera ky'eby'obufuzi, ng'oggyeko olw'okuba n'okuba n'ekitongole kya Italian era n'ekitongole kya Amakula Film.
items.ref: Ekisaawe ky'ebya ffirimu mu Uganda kyetooloolera ku kukyusa mbeera z'abantu, okusiima kugende eri Italian cooperation ne Amakula Film.

items.hyp: Abantu bangi mu Gulu bangi bamu ku buli kikumi, era kati ekitongole ky'ekitongole kyali kikola okugenda mu bitundu ebirala.
items.ref: Musanyufu nnyo n'abantu b'e Gulu pulojekiti gy'eddukanyizibwa nti tebakoma bukomi ku kutambula ngendo mpanvu okugenda mu bifo bye baagala.

items.hyp: Abantu b'omu Gulu baagala okukola embeera nga bwe kiba kubanga nga kiba kubanga nga kiba kuba nga kiba n'okukuba nga kiba n'okukuba nga kuba nga kuba nga n'okuba nga kibadde.
items.ref: Abantu b'e Gulu bavumu mu obunnyogovu bw'ekiro okutuukira ddala mu matumbi budde.

items.hyp: CinemArena y'omu ku kitongole ky'eby'okulonda mu Italy.
items.ref: Ekisaawe ky'ebya ffirimu kivujjirirwa ekitebe kya Italy Development Cooperation office.

items.hyp: Ennyonyi ennyingi ez'omu nsi yonna ezisukka mu bitundu bya Uganda.
items.ref: Emmotoka y'abasuubuzi etambula yeetooloola ekibuga n'ebitundu by'ekyalo mu Uganda.

items.hyp: Abamu ku bamu ku bamu ku ngeri y'omu ku bantu abamu okubwako era nga bamu bamanyi bamu, baagala okukola amagye.
items.ref: Abazinyi abazina amazina Amacholi basanyusa abantu ku nnaku ez'okukola bongera okunyumisa ekintu.

items.hyp: Abakulembeze baali bagamba nti ebikolwa bye baali bimu ku bantu bwa Barak Obama bwe bagamba nti "Yes We Can" kyali kyagenda nnyo.
items.ref: Abategesi ba pulojekiti bagamba nti omukutu gwabwe ogw'empuliziganya gwekuusa ku ngombo ya Baraka Obama eya "Yes We Can" eyamuyamba okutuuka mu woofiisi.

items.hyp: Marco Ballerini, omumyuka w'ekitongole kyabwe yagamba nti okukola okwo kugenda mu mbeera yali asobola okukola amagye amalala agamu okukola mu mbeera y'omukaaga.
items.ref: Marco Ballerini, akulira pulojekiti yagambye nti mu kukola ekyo abantu abalina obukugu bajja kukulemberamu enkulaakulana y'omu maaso.

items.hyp: Ekitongole ky'okulonda ekyo kyali kikola mu sub-counties ezisukka mu 20 mu disitulikiti y'e Gulu okuva nga Jjuuni 25 ne kugenda nga Jjulaayi 25.
items.ref: Pulojekiti egenda okukolebwa mu magombolola agasukka amakumi abiri mu disitulikiti y'e Gulu yatandika nga abiri mu ttaano Ogwomukaaga era ya kukomekkerezebwa ng'abiri mu ttaano Ogwomusanvu.

items.hyp: Abantu abalala mu bibiina by'e Gulu abali mu kiseera kino tebamanyi.
items.ref: Abantu b'omu bitundu by'e Gulu pulojekiti gyeeri mu kukolebwa kati basanyufu nnyo.

items.hyp: Baagamba nti abakungu baali baali bamanyiddwa mu UPDF.
items.ref: Baanokolayo nti abamu ku bannaabwe baayingizibwa eggye lya Uganda People's Deforce Force.

items.hyp: Abantu abalala baali baagala mu maaso n'ebitongole ebirala ebikolera eby'okwerinda, era ne baali baagala okukola abantu abalimi.
items.ref: Abalala baalina ebitongole by'ebyokwerinda bye baalinako akakwate ebyabayambanga okulondoola n'okumanyisa Abasiraamu.

items.hyp: Abakungu ba ADF abalala Kakooza Ahmad ne Dada Mukibi baatandika okusasula ssente.
items.ref: Bammemba ba Allied Democratic Forces babiri, Kakooza Ahmad ne Dada Mukibi bammiddwa looni.

items.hyp: Okuva ku kitale e Kitante, eky'okukwata abantu abalwanirira ADF, tekyali kyali kyali ky'okukola.
items.ref: Woofiisi ekola ku kunoonyereza n'okulondoola e Kitante eyali ekola ku kutabaganya enkola za ADF yali tekyakola.

items.hyp: Mu kiseera ekyo okukola ku gavumenti, ab'ekibiina kya ADF abali mu bbomu be bafuna obulungi obulungi.
items.ref: Mu kukola ne Gavumenti, obulamu bwabwe bubadde bwongedde okuteekebwa mu katyabaga okuva eri bannaabwe ba Allied Democratic Forces abakyali mu nsiko.

items.hyp: Baalowooza ku kyetaagisa okufa bamu abalala nga Lyavaala, Zilyawulawo, Junju, Kasakya, Issa Twatera, Benon Musisi, Kagimu.
items.ref: Baayogera ku kufa kw'ekibwatukira okwa bannaabwe nga Lyavaale, Zilyawulawo, Junju, Kasakya, Issa Twatera, Benon Musisi, Kagimu.

items.hyp: Abakulu bangi baali bateebwa era abo abaali baali baali baali bavuganya n'ebitono ebikwata ku bantu.
items.ref: Abamu ku bannaabwe battibwa mu ngeri etaategeerekeka era abamu ku baaliko abayeekera ba Allied Democratic Forces baatiisatiisa okuttukiza ebikolwa y'obutujju.

items.hyp: Okutabwa 2008, abakungu ba gavumenti baakubaganya okukolagana n'okukwatagana n'ebyo ebyali bivuganya nti abalwanyi ba ADF abali mu buvuddeyo gavumenti.
items.ref: Mu Gwekkumi gwa 2008, abakulira ebitongole by'ebyokwerinda baasisinkana okukubaganya ebirowoozo ku nsonga y'abaliko abayeekera ba ADF balumiriza gavumenti okubakozesa.

items.hyp: Abawagizi b'ekibiina kya ADF abalala baagamba gavumenti okukola abawagizi era nga tebamalirira.
items.ref: Abaaliko abayeekera ba Allied Democratic Forces baalumizizza gavumenti okubakozesa n'ebasuulawo nga tebasasudde.

items.hyp: Ebyo ebyaliwo mu Kampala nga Jjulaayi 11 byaliwo okukkirizibwa nti bamanyi bannalukalala ab'ekibiina kya ADF ne bannamawulire ebyali bivuganya ne Somalia.
items.ref: Obulumbanyi bwa bbomu obwali mu Kampala nga 11 Ogwomusanvu bwava ku nkolagana wakati wa ADF ne bamukwatammundu Abasiraamu aba Al-Shabaab abasangibwa e Somalia.

items.hyp: Olw'okuba abamu ku ngeri y'emu era n'okuba nnyo, abamu ku ngeri y'emu bannamawulire ba ADF baali bamukyalawo okukola ku nnyo y'abo abali mu bibiina bye baali bamukola.
items.ref: Olw'embeera enzibu era ey'okwennyamira gye bawangaaliramu, bannamawulire ba Allied Democratic Forces abatamanyi kiddako baddiziddwa mu bikolwa by'obutujju.

items.hyp: Abdusalam Lukwebe Mwebe n'abalala abalala baali bamemba bangi mu b'ebibiina bya ADF.
items.ref: Abdusalam Lukwebe Mwebe n'abalala be bamu ku baali bammemba ba Allied Democratic Forces.

items.hyp: Olupapula lwa Independent olwa Jjulaayi 2010 lwalimu nti abantu ba ADF abalala tebamanyiddwa era nti bamuwagira bwa gavumenti.
items.ref: Independent w'Ogomusanvu, 2010, yawandiika nti abooluganda b'abaaliko mmemba wa ADF tebafuna buyambi kyokka ng'abaami baabwe baafiira ku mirimu gya Gavumenti.

items.hyp: Akakiiko k'eby'okulonda mu Kampala kati kikolera nnyo ku ngeri y'emirimu mu bantu b'omu Kampala.
items.ref: Kampala City Council Authority lubeerera ekubiriza bannakampala okuba abayonjo.

items.hyp: Ekyo kyali kikola okuba nti abakungu baabwe nga Rwigyema Shafik ne Tumusiime Hassan baali bamanyi.
items.ref: Ekino kiviiriddemu bannaabwe nga Rwigyema Shafik ne Tumusiime Hassan ebuzibu.
